sourceBrief: 3m x 9m Kwila decking, 140mm decking boards, 0.14m high off ground, attaching onto an existing deck, new substructure required.
notes: Same geometry and scope as REAL-JOB-01 with Kwila surface instead of Vitex/Hardwood.

limitations: No framing specification supplied — planning takeoff uses disclosed estimating layout assumptions.
